question: How is the vital air described as present within all living beings?
premises: The air is filled with breath or wind
The air is situated in all beings
This presence is universal among living beings
inference: The breath-filled vital air is situated within all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement of saṃsthitam with vāyuḥ is syntactically loose.
plain_english: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
